name: Nomura Micro Science Co., Ltd.
summary: Nomura Micro Science Co., Ltd. engages in the design, construction, and sale of water production equipment in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers water treatment plants and equipment, including pure and ultra-pure water systems, pharmaceutical water production systems, wastewater treatment systems, and water reclamation systems.
